hypothesis: Pretrain a task-agnostic autoregressive SMILES model on only the unlabeled corpus, freeze a copy as the prior, and adapt a fresh task-local agent with elite-only Augmented Hill-Climb likelihood updates from each current oracle feedback batch; after sustained reward improvement, beam-enumerate the updated agent's highest-probability partial token trajectories, extract a small pool of recurrent connected molecular motifs, and self-condition later de novo proposals by rejecting complete ancestral samples that contain none of those motifs.
method_thesis: Train a task-agnostic autoregressive SMILES model only on the allowed unlabeled corpus, freeze a copy as the prior, and restart a trainable agent for each independent objective session. Generate the first proposals ancestrally, then use returned oracle scores to apply top-fraction prior-regularized likelihood updates to the agent. Whenever the recent reward trajectory shows sustained improvement, run Beam Enumeration on the current agent without calling the oracle: expand its most probable partial token trajectories, convert chemically interpretable partial strings into connected molecular substructures, and retain a small task-local pool of recurrent motifs. Fill subsequent evaluator-announced batches by sampling complete SMILES de novo from the agent and locally rejecting any valid novel sample that lacks every pooled motif; canonicalize and remove already evaluated or within-batch duplicates before submission. The enumerated objects are transient partial token trajectories, not whole candidate molecules, and neither they nor any corpus molecule are scored, ranked, retrieved, or submitted as a finite library. Thus oracle feedback changes both the policy and a dynamic structural gate on fresh generation, concentrating the 290 adaptive calls on chemistry expressed by successful policy updates while the only success criterion remains the mean of the five independent final Top-1 scores.

method_tags.acquisition_mechanism: membership in a task-local beam-derived motif pool before oracle submission, with no scoring of the transient internal samples
method_tags.learning_mechanism: offline corpus language-model training plus task-local top-fraction prior-regularized likelihood updates from current oracle feedback
method_tags.proposal_mechanism: dynamic top-probability beam expansion for motif extraction followed by motif-gated rejection sampling of complete de novo SMILES
method_tags.representation: tokenized SMILES plus RDKit-extracted connected substructures from partial token trajectories

applicability_conditions: The unlabeled corpus supports a task-agnostic autoregressive SMILES prior with sufficient complete, valid, and novel ancestral-sampling yield to supply both direct and motif-gated batches.
Returned oracle scores vary enough within current feedback batches to identify an elite fraction and create nonzero reward-augmented likelihood targets that move the task-local agent.

Within the 29 adaptive feedback rounds, reward progress is sustained long enough to trigger Beam Enumeration and the updated policy assigns concentrated probability to chemically interpretable partial trajectories with recurrent connected motifs.

Motifs recurrent in high-probability partial trajectories identify productive structural regularities rather than syntactic artifacts, and useful full molecules containing them remain reachable under ancestral sampling from the same updated agent.
Motif gating is selective enough to concentrate proposals but not so restrictive that rejection sampling fails to fill an evaluator-announced batch within proposal and task-time limits.

The method may underperform when useful chemistry lies outside prior support, feedback is flat or noisy enough to prevent a stable improvement trigger, partial SMILES rarely parse into meaningful connected substructures, or the best molecules require structural novelty excluded by an early recurrent-motif pool.
research_intent.falsifier: The root mechanism is falsified if current-batch oracle rewards do not produce traceable elite-only updates toward reward-augmented frozen-prior targets, if a satisfied sustained-improvement predicate does not produce recurrent connected motifs traceable to high-probability partial beam paths, or if the active motif pool does not actually gate later complete de novo samples so that emitted molecules contain a retained beam-derived motif.
research_intent.implementation_change: Implement prepare mode to tokenize the unlabeled corpus, train and publish a compact autoregressive SMILES language model, its vocabulary and configuration, and fixed held-out language-model and sampling diagnostics. Implement run mode to seed every RNG from init, load identical frozen-prior and trainable-agent copies on logical cuda:0, and fill the first evaluator-announced batch by direct ancestral sampling with sanitization, canonicalization, and local novelty filtering. After each observe message, associate accepted scores with their exact sampled token trajectories and update the agent only on the highest-reward fraction of that current batch by minimizing the squared gap between agent sequence log likelihood and a reward-augmented frozen-prior likelihood target, without experience replay. Maintain a deterministic recent-reward history; whenever its configured sustained-improvement criterion is met, run no-oracle Beam Enumeration over high-probability partial agent trajectories, retain only partial strings that RDKit can interpret as connected substructures, count their recurrence across beam paths, and refresh a bounded task-local pool of the recurrent motifs. For subsequent suggestions, sample complete molecules de novo from the agent and locally reject any valid novel sample that matches none of the active motifs, as well as invalid, evaluated, previously emitted, or within-batch duplicate molecules, until exactly the batch size announced by init is ready. Never submit or score beam paths, retrieve whole corpus molecules, enumerate a fixed whole-molecule candidate set, or use rejected internal samples as labeled training data.
research_intent.mechanism: Pretrain a task-agnostic autoregressive SMILES model on only the unlabeled corpus, freeze a copy as the prior, and adapt a fresh task-local agent with elite-only Augmented Hill-Climb likelihood updates from each current oracle feedback batch; after sustained reward improvement, beam-enumerate the updated agent's highest-probability partial token trajectories, extract a small pool of recurrent connected molecular motifs, and self-condition later de novo proposals by rejecting complete ancestral samples that contain none of those motifs.
research_intent.observed_bottleneck: Only 290 adaptive oracle calls remain after the ten fixed observations, yielding 29 feedback boundaries at batch size 10; a corpus-pretrained SMILES policy must turn sparse batchwise rewards into useful token-probability changes quickly, while direct ancestral sampling can still spend scarce calls on valid but structurally diffuse molecules that do not express the recurrent chemistry revealed by successful policy updates.

applicability_conditions: Supported when the unlabeled corpus trains a productive compact SMILES prior: the fixed holdout NLL decreased by 3.640118083895577 on 97,526 identical prediction tokens, and the seeded prior check produced 222 unique valid canonical molecules from 256 complete samples.

Supported when each current feedback batch has enough reward variation to define a useful top half: all 145 batches had positive elite-minus-batch reward gaps and positive reward-target displacement, all 725 logged targets reproduced the registered formula, and mean elite log-likelihood gain was positive on every task.

Supported when the recent-reward predicate fires within 29 updates: every task produced 5 to 7 eligible refreshes, and trigger execution plus ineligible pool preservation were both perfectly consistent with the configured four-round trend and three-round cooldown.

Recurrent interpretable partial support was sustained on deco_hop, drd2_docking, sitagliptin_mpo, and zaleplon_mpo, where every refresh retained a nonempty pool; it was only transient on median_2, whose final five refreshes retained no motif. Applicability therefore requires at least three high-probability beam paths to share a parseable connected prefix.

Supported when useful complete molecules remain reachable through the active gate: on 104 active rounds the gate enriched motif prevalence from 0.3616133518776078 before gating to 1.0 among emissions and filled every ten-molecule batch, despite rejecting 1,836 valid novel motif-absent samples.

Operationally supported under this seed, batch size 10, and 290-call adaptive horizon: all 145 rounds filled, all five tasks reached 300 oracle calls, and no invalid or duplicate proposal reached the evaluator. The lowest active-round raw yield of 0.06493506493506493 limits transfer to tighter proposal or time budgets.

The current evidence supports dynamic beam-derived membership and task-specific pool changes, but not the causal productivity of every retained motif. Transfer is weakest when high-value chemistry lies outside prior support, feedback does not sustain the trigger, partial SMILES do not parse recurrently, or an early generic motif gate excludes necessary structural novelty.

Conclusions are limited to seed 0 and a root with no Parent comparison; multi-seed reliability and incremental benefit over an otherwise identical ungated Augmented Hill-Climb policy remain unmeasured.

observable_measurements.parent_value: No Parent Algorithm Node exists. The pre-registered zero-trace baseline has zero retained motifs supported by distinct high-probability beam paths and no enumerated path provenance.
observable_measurements.value: The 31 triggered refreshes retained 1,488/1,488 enumerated partial paths with path id, 18 token ids, raw partial string, cumulative beam log probability, parse outcome, and extracted connected-substructure records. Of these paths, 559 were parseable and supplied 882 extraction records, yielding 226 candidate-motif records. Ninety-five motif occurrences were retained across refreshes; all 95/95 have at least the configured three distinct supporting path ids (observed support 3 to 41), and every supporting id resolves to a retained high-probability path whose extraction list contains that motif. Thus the retained-motif trace rate is 1.0 versus the registered zero-trace reference, and every pool respected the six-motif bound. Twenty-six of 31 refreshes produced a nonempty recurrent pool (0.8387096774193549). The five empty refreshes all occurred on median_2 at rounds 15, 19, 23, 26, and 29; the first had two parseable paths but no motif reaching recurrence three, and the last four had no parseable beam path.

observable_measurements.parent_value: No Parent Algorithm Node exists. A static-pool reference has zero pre/post prefix displacement, zero additions and removals, unchanged recurrence, and Jaccard overlap 1.0 at every refresh.
observable_measurements.value: All 1,488 seeded beam paths at triggered refreshes have paired length-normalized likelihoods under the snapshotted pre-update agent and the post-update agent, and all 1,488 have nonzero displacement above 1e-12 in magnitude: 999 positive and 489 negative, with mean signed displacement 0.0037991397122862517 and mean absolute displacement 0.007248031376029855. Across the 31 refreshes the task-local pools recorded 27 additions and 9 removals, changed identity set on 14 refreshes, and had Jaccard overlap ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 with mean 0.6701612903225806. Among 68 motifs retained in two consecutive refreshes, distinct-path recurrence changed on 55 (0.8088235294117647). Sixteen different motifs were retained overall, and final pools diverged by objective: deco_hop retained six sulfone-related motifs, drd2_docking retained six amine/alkyl motifs, sitagliptin_mpo retained four sulfone-related motifs, zaleplon_mpo retained O=S=O and O=CO, and median_2 ended empty. These paired policy shifts, additions/removals, recurrence changes, and task divergence are inconsistent with replaying one static corpus motif list.

observable_measurements.name: novel_valid_motif_gated_sampling_yield
observable_measurements.parent_value: No Parent Algorithm Node exists. The zero-success reference has no novel valid complete ancestral emission and cannot fill an announced batch; the node's own ungated rounds provide the direct operational comparator for the additional gating cost.
observable_measurements.value: Across all 145 suggestion rounds, 4,074 ancestral sequences yielded 4,064 completions and 1,450 emitted unique valid canonical molecules, for aggregate raw-sample emission yield 0.3559155621011291 and round-level range 0.06493506493506493 to 1.0. The complete accounting is 10 non-completions, 771 sanitization/validity failures, 7 evaluated-molecule collisions, 0 prior-emission collisions, 0 within-batch collisions, and 1,836 active-motif-absence rejections; these categories plus emissions reconcile exactly on every round. The 41 ungated rounds emitted 410/533 sampled sequences (0.7692307692307693), whereas the 104 gated rounds emitted 1,040/3,541 (0.2937023439706298), making the gate's rejection cost visible. Nevertheless, every one of 145 evaluator-announced batches contained exactly 10 emissions. The five task trajectories reproduce those emissions in order and each contains 290 accepted adaptive proposals; summary.json reports status ok, all 300 oracle calls per task, and zero evaluator-level invalid or duplicate attempts.

possible_failure_causes: Beam recurrence was task-dependent: five of seven median_2 triggers produced no retained motif, and the round-15 empty refresh disabled the gate for the remaining 14 suggestion rounds. Partial strings that do not parse or recur can therefore remove structural self-conditioning even when the reward predicate is satisfied.

Motif gating materially reduced proposal efficiency: aggregate raw-sample yield was 0.2937023439706298 on gated rounds versus 0.7692307692307693 on ungated rounds, with one active round requiring 154 sampled sequences for 10 emissions. A narrower future policy or motif pool could exhaust the attempt or time allowance even though all current batches filled.

The retained motifs include small generic or valence-normalized substructures such as O=S=O, C[SH]=O, O=CO, and short carbon or amine chains. Distinct-path recurrence and valid substructure matching prove execution, but do not by themselves prove that each motif is a productive objective-specific chemical regularity rather than a common syntactic fragment.

Elite optimization was directionally positive but not uniform: 76/725 selected trajectories failed to move closer to their own reward-augmented target, 49/145 updates had at least one such trajectory, one update moved none of its five elites, and sitagliptin_mpo had the weakest pooled movement at 103/145 elites. Shared-parameter interference or two-step overshoot can weaken the policy signal from which motifs are extracted.

Pool identity changed on only 14/31 refreshes, including the first empty-to-nonempty refresh on each task; 17 refreshes retained the same set even though most overlapping recurrence counts changed. The structural gate can therefore remain unchanged across several eligible feedback events.

This root has only screening seed 0 and no Parent or gate ablation. The evidence establishes activation and full-budget operation, but does not isolate how much terminal objective value came from the beam-derived gate rather than the underlying elite-only policy update or establish multi-seed stability.

Every one of the 1,836 motif-absent samples was rejected, and all 1,040/1,040 emitted proposals contained at least one motif in that round's active beam-derived pool, giving emitted prevalence 1.0 and absolute enrichment 0.6383866481223922. observable_measurements.name: novel_valid_motif_gated_sampling_yield
observable_measurements.parent_value: No Parent Algorithm Node exists. The zero-success reference has no novel valid complete ancestral emission and cannot fill an announced batch; the node's own ungated rounds provide the direct operational comparator for the additional gating cost.
observable_measurements.value: Across all 145 suggestion rounds, 4,074 ancestral sequences yielded 4,064 completions and 1,450 emitted unique valid canonical molecules, for aggregate raw-sample emission yield 0.3559155621011291 and round-level range 0.06493506493506493 to 1.0. The complete accounting is 10 non-completions, 771 sanitization/validity failures, 7 evaluated-molecule collisions, 0 prior-emission collisions, 0 within-batch collisions, and 1,836 active-motif-absence rejections; these categories plus emissions reconcile exactly on every round. The 41 ungated rounds emitted 410/533 sampled sequences (0.7692307692307693), whereas the 104 gated rounds emitted 1,040/3,541 (0.2937023439706298), making the gate's rejection cost visible. Nevertheless, every one of 145 evaluator-announced batches contained exactly 10 emissions. The five task trajectories reproduce those emissions in order and each contains 290 accepted adaptive proposals; summary.json reports status ok, all 300 oracle calls per task, and zero evaluator-level invalid or duplicate attempts.

possible_failure_causes: Beam recurrence was task-dependent: five of seven median_2 triggers produced no retained motif, and the round-15 empty refresh disabled the gate for the remaining 14 suggestion rounds. Partial strings that do not parse or recur can therefore remove structural self-conditioning even when the reward predicate is satisfied.

Motif gating materially reduced proposal efficiency: aggregate raw-sample yield was 0.2937023439706298 on gated rounds versus 0.7692307692307693 on ungated rounds, with one active round requiring 154 sampled sequences for 10 emissions. A narrower future policy or motif pool could exhaust the attempt or time allowance even though all current batches filled.

The retained motifs include small generic or valence-normalized substructures such as O=S=O, C[SH]=O, O=CO, and short carbon or amine chains. Distinct-path recurrence and valid substructure matching prove execution, but do not by themselves prove that each motif is a productive objective-specific chemical regularity rather than a common syntactic fragment.

Elite optimization was directionally positive but not uniform: 76/725 selected trajectories failed to move closer to their own reward-augmented target, 49/145 updates had at least one such trajectory, one update moved none of its five elites, and sitagliptin_mpo had the weakest pooled movement at 103/145 elites. Shared-parameter interference or two-step overshoot can weaken the policy signal from which motifs are extracted.

Pool identity changed on only 14/31 refreshes, including the first empty-to-nonempty refresh on each task; 17 refreshes retained the same set even though most overlapping recurrence counts changed. The structural gate can therefore remain unchanged across several eligible feedback events.

This root has only screening seed 0 and no Parent or gate ablation. The evidence establishes activation and full-budget operation, but does not isolate how much terminal objective value came from the beam-derived gate rather than the underlying elite-only policy update or establish multi-seed stability.

applicability_conditions: Supported when the unlabeled corpus trains a productive compact SMILES prior: the fixed holdout NLL decreased by 3.640118083895577 on 97,526 identical prediction tokens, and the seeded prior check produced 222 unique valid canonical molecules from 256 complete samples.

Supported when each current feedback batch has enough reward variation to define a useful top half: all 145 batches had positive elite-minus-batch reward gaps and positive reward-target displacement, all 725 logged targets reproduced the registered formula, and mean elite log-likelihood gain was positive on every task.

Supported when the recent-reward predicate fires within 29 updates: every task produced 5 to 7 eligible refreshes, and trigger execution plus ineligible pool preservation were both perfectly consistent with the configured four-round trend and three-round cooldown.

Recurrent interpretable partial support was sustained on deco_hop, drd2_docking, sitagliptin_mpo, and zaleplon_mpo, where every refresh retained a nonempty pool; it was only transient on median_2, whose final five refreshes retained no motif. Applicability therefore requires at least three high-probability beam paths to share a parseable connected prefix.

Supported when useful complete molecules remain reachable through the active gate: on 104 active rounds the gate enriched motif prevalence from 0.3616133518776078 before gating to 1.0 among emissions and filled every ten-molecule batch, despite rejecting 1,836 valid novel motif-absent samples.

Operationally supported under this seed, batch size 10, and 290-call adaptive horizon: all 145 rounds filled, all five tasks reached 300 oracle calls, and no invalid or duplicate proposal reached the evaluator. The lowest active-round raw yield of 0.06493506493506493 limits transfer to tighter proposal or time budgets.

The current evidence supports dynamic beam-derived membership and task-specific pool changes, but not the causal productivity of every retained motif. Transfer is weakest when high-value chemistry lies outside prior support, feedback does not sustain the trigger, partial SMILES do not parse recurrently, or an early generic motif gate excludes necessary structural novelty.

Conclusions are limited to seed 0 and a root with no Parent comparison; multi-seed reliability and incremental benefit over an otherwise identical ungated Augmented Hill-Climb policy remain unmeasured.

applicability_conditions: The unlabeled corpus supports a task-agnostic autoregressive SMILES prior with sufficient complete, valid, and novel ancestral-sampling yield to supply both direct and motif-gated batches.
Returned oracle scores vary enough within current feedback batches to identify an elite fraction and create nonzero reward-augmented likelihood targets that move the task-local agent.

Within the 29 adaptive feedback rounds, reward progress is sustained long enough to trigger Beam Enumeration and the updated policy assigns concentrated probability to chemically interpretable partial trajectories with recurrent connected motifs.

Motifs recurrent in high-probability partial trajectories identify productive structural regularities rather than syntactic artifacts, and useful full molecules containing them remain reachable under ancestral sampling from the same updated agent.
Motif gating is selective enough to concentrate proposals but not so restrictive that rejection sampling fails to fill an evaluator-announced batch within proposal and task-time limits.

The method may underperform when useful chemistry lies outside prior support, feedback is flat or noisy enough to prevent a stable improvement trigger, partial SMILES rarely parse into meaningful connected substructures, or the best molecules require structural novelty excluded by an early recurrent-motif pool.
research_intent.falsifier: The root mechanism is falsified if current-batch oracle rewards do not produce traceable elite-only updates toward reward-augmented frozen-prior targets, if a satisfied sustained-improvement predicate does not produce recurrent connected motifs traceable to high-probability partial beam paths, or if the active motif pool does not actually gate later complete de novo samples so that emitted molecules contain a retained beam-derived motif.
research_intent.implementation_change: Implement prepare mode to tokenize the unlabeled corpus, train and publish a compact autoregressive SMILES language model, its vocabulary and configuration, and fixed held-out language-model and sampling diagnostics. Implement run mode to seed every RNG from init, load identical frozen-prior and trainable-agent copies on logical cuda:0, and fill the first evaluator-announced batch by direct ancestral sampling with sanitization, canonicalization, and local novelty filtering. After each observe message, associate accepted scores with their exact sampled token trajectories and update the agent only on the highest-reward fraction of that current batch by minimizing the squared gap between agent sequence log likelihood and a reward-augmented frozen-prior likelihood target, without experience replay. Maintain a deterministic recent-reward history; whenever its configured sustained-improvement criterion is met, run no-oracle Beam Enumeration over high-probability partial agent trajectories, retain only partial strings that RDKit can interpret as connected substructures, count their recurrence across beam paths, and refresh a bounded task-local pool of the recurrent motifs. For subsequent suggestions, sample complete molecules de novo from the agent and locally reject any valid novel sample that matches none of the active motifs, as well as invalid, evaluated, previously emitted, or within-batch duplicate molecules, until exactly the batch size announced by init is ready. Never submit or score beam paths, retrieve whole corpus molecules, enumerate a fixed whole-molecule candidate set, or use rejected internal samples as labeled training data.
research_intent.mechanism: Pretrain a task-agnostic autoregressive SMILES model on only the unlabeled corpus, freeze a copy as the prior, and adapt a fresh task-local agent with elite-only Augmented Hill-Climb likelihood updates from each current oracle feedback batch; after sustained reward improvement, beam-enumerate the updated agent's highest-probability partial token trajectories, extract a small pool of recurrent connected molecular motifs, and self-condition later de novo proposals by rejecting complete ancestral samples that contain none of those motifs.
research_intent.observed_bottleneck: Only 290 adaptive oracle calls remain after the ten fixed observations, yielding 29 feedback boundaries at batch size 10; a corpus-pretrained SMILES policy must turn sparse batchwise rewards into useful token-probability changes quickly, while direct ancestral sampling can still spend scarce calls on valid but structurally diffuse molecules that do not express the recurrent chemistry revealed by successful policy updates.
